page: Microsoft Azure EC32ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECadsv6 server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture with AMD processors, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server includes 1229 GB of local storage and is premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. The combination of dedicated AMD compute cores, a high memory-to-core ratio, and substantial local storage capacity provides a balanced profile for memory-intensive workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of a GPU. Appropriate workloads include relational databases, in-memory caches, data analytics, and enterprise applications.
description: Microsoft Azure EC32ads_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the ECadsv6 family, powered by AMD processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high-density 8.0 GB of memory per core ratio. The server is equipped with 1229 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage for high-performance disk configurations. Lacking integrated GPUs, this instance focuses its resource allocation on memory capacity and dedicated compute. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications, relational databases, in-memory caching, and data analytics pipelines that require significant memory capacity and local storage without the need for hardware acceleration.
